brief: Run forced cooling continuously through the overnight period rather than allowing the thermostat to drop the stages out, as detailed in MG-025. On events extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply a further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward in accordance with MG-021. Where the unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure, per MG-023.
